concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – User Story 1 – Data Acquisition & Pre‑processing (US‑1)
concerns.text: Task T065 (batch‑effect correction) is scheduled before task T014 (normalization) and T065a (confound regression). Normalization (VST/TPM) must precede batch‑effect correction and confound regression to operate on comparable expression values. Reorder so T014 → T065/T065a → downstream steps.

Tasks T300, T301, T302, T303, T304, T305, and T306 are all marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but have clear producer‑consumer relationships (e.g., T301 consumes the file generated by T300, T302 validates T301’s output, etc.). The `[P]` tag is unsafe here; either remove the tag or enforce sequential ordering.
